# Local documentation templates

This is the minimal template set for contributors working directly in this repository:

- Suggestion: suggestion-template.md
- ADR: adr-template.md
- Issue: issue-template.md
- Bug: bug-template.md
- QA: qa-template.md

The root IPLMS repository owns the full cross-system documentation catalog. Copy the smallest
template that matches the work, then link related root/module documents when the change crosses
repository boundaries.
